record.title: AI for Humanity: French national strategy for artificial intelligence
record.issuing_body: President of the Republic and Government of France
record.summary: France's national AI strategy, presented by President Macron on 29 March 2018 on the basis of the report by Cedric Villani. It rests on four pillars: an AI research and innovation ecosystem, an open data policy, public funding and projects in selected sectors, and an ethical and political debate. On ethics it commits the State to publish the code of the algorithms it uses, to track bias, to keep humans in the decision and to non-discrimination, and it proposes an international expert body on AI.
record.notes: The strategy was announced in the President's speech at the Collège de France on 29 March 2018. The Government's press kit of 28 November 2018 on the national AI research strategy describes the measures that carry it out, including a research programme led by Inria and an ethics axis.
